title: kissed irish avocado fried-rice
description: a creamy, crispy, crowd-pleasing irish dish that's perfect for brunch or a weeknight dinner. made with hass avocado pulp and dairy-free friendly.

ingredients.name: avocado hass pulp
ingredients.notes: ripe but still slightly firm to the touch

ingredients.name: irish sausages
ingredients.notes: look for sausages with a good balance of fat and lean meat

ingredients.name: irish brown bread
ingredients.notes: stale bread works best for fried rice

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: use a sweet onion variety like vidalia or red onion

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: mellow garlic flavor is best for this dish

ingredients.name: irish cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: add a sprinkle of grated cheese on top before serving for extra flavor

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.notes: use green onions or scallions for garnish

instructions: cook the irish sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking them up with a spoon as they cook.
remove the cooked sausages from the skillet and set them aside on a plate.
add more oil to the skillet if necessary, then sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
add the cubed bread to the skillet and stir-fry until it's lightly toasted and fragrant.
add the cooked sausages back into the skillet, followed by the grated cheese, and stir-fry until everything is well combined.
stir in the avocado hass pulp, breaking it up with a spoon as you go.
taste and adjust the seasoning with black pepper as needed.
heat a large amount of oil in a deep frying pan to 350f (175c).
carefully add small portions of the fried rice mixture to the hot oil, frying until crispy and golden brown.
drain the fried rice on paper towels and serve hot, garnished with thinly sliced scallions.
